name: softube-tape-drum-glue-warm
description: Warm + fat drum-bus tape glue via Softube Tape. Type B (fattest/darkest — measured centroid 2113 vs dry 2223, most LF) at 15 IPS (head bump lands on the kick), Amount 6 for audible-but-clean compression (crest ~ -0.5..-0.9 dB), Crosstalk 50 for center weight / mono glue. Warmth comes from the tape (Type+speed), not EQ boosts — the user's preferred warm+tight drum-bus character.
intended_for: a balanced stereo drum bus that wants warmth + controlled bottom (the warm/tight pref). Insert before the master; do NOT limit here.
plugin_build: Softube 'Tape.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE — authorized on this rig, re-verify on a new machine). 13 of 15 params are STRING ENUMS → must go through this harness, not apply-vst-chain's float dict.
notes: Amount is GAIN-COMPENSATED → it barely moves tone; it moves crest. 6.0 ≈ -0.5..-0.9 dB crest on a drum bus. Push to ~7-8 for more glue, but 10 CRUSHES (-4.9 dB crest + 3rd-harmonic spit).

For a brighter result swap high_freq_trim to a positive value (BOOST = +566 Hz centroid); for warmer use 'CUT' (-514). For tighter lows go tape_speed '30 IPS' (brighter + tighter) and crosstalk 'OFF'.
Crosstalk NARROWS/glues (corr up, mono-sum loss down) — it is NOT a widener; it's inert on mono.

Verify: measure-loudness (crest), measure-spectrum (centroid/tilt DOWN = warming), measure-stereo (crosstalk), render-ab loudness-matched. Pairs with [[warm-drum-bus]] / [[drum-bus-warm-tight-preference]].
